title: Faisal Town Block C Islamabad – Map, Plots & Prices
description: Explore Faisal Town Block C in Phase 1/F-18 Islamabad with map guidance, plot sizes, current prices, houses, resale availability and buyer checks.
h1: Faisal Town Block C – Phase 1, F-18 Islamabad
intro:
Faisal Town Block C is an established residential block in Faisal Town Phase 1/F-18 Islamabad, located near Gate 2 and connected with the wider Phase 1 road network.

Buyers commonly compare Block C by plot size, exact street, access, possession, surrounding development and current resale price. Residential options range from smaller 5-marla plots to larger 1-kanal properties, but the exact plot and documents should always be verified before payment.
body:
## Faisal Town Block C overview

Faisal Town Block C is part of Faisal Town Phase 1/F-18 Islamabad.

It is an established residential area with active plot, house and rental activity. Current Phase 1 project material places Block C near Faisal Town Gate 2 on the Rawalpindi-Kohat Road and shows it connected with Blocks A, B and B-1.

For buyers, the important factors are the exact plot or house location, street width, access, possession, surrounding development and total purchase cost.

A block-level average is useful only for orientation. The final decision should be made on the specific property.

## Faisal Town Block C location and map

Block C is positioned near Faisal Town Gate 2 and is connected to the wider Phase 1 road network.

Use the correct Phase 1/F-18 map when reviewing a listing.

For the exact property, confirm:

- plot number
- street number
- road width
- access route
- corner or standard position
- main-road or internal-street location
- nearby commercial or community areas
- surrounding occupancy

Because Block C shares connections with other Phase 1 areas, a map helps establish how the property relates to Block A, Block B and B-1.

A physical site visit is still recommended before making an offer.

## Plot sizes in Faisal Town Block C

Current Phase 1 material lists the following residential sizes in Block C:

- 5 marla – approximately 25 x 50
- 8 marla – approximately 30 x 60
- 10 marla – approximately 35 x 70
- 14 marla – approximately 40 x 80
- 1 kanal – approximately 50 x 90

Block C therefore offers a broader small-to-large residential size range than some other Phase 1 blocks.

Always verify the actual dimensions from the ownership or transfer documents rather than relying only on the rounded marla description.

## Faisal Town Block C plots for sale

Block C has an active resale market.

Current listings include residential plots in several sizes, together with houses and flats. Availability changes frequently, so any listing should be treated as a dated market example rather than permanent inventory.

Before comparing prices, establish whether the property is:

- a numbered plot
- possession property
- fully paid
- carrying outstanding dues
- corner or park-facing
- main-road or internal
- ready for construction
- carrying any special-location premium

Two plots with the same size can still differ materially in value.

## Block C prices

There is no single fixed price for Block C.

Current portal price-index data shows substantial variation by size and date.

Recent examples include:

- 5-marla residential plots around the PKR 12.35 million index level
- 10-marla residential plots around the PKR 20.02 million index level
- 1-kanal residential plots around the PKR 30.22 million index level

These are market indicators based on portal data, not official Faisal Town prices and not guaranteed transaction values.

Actual asking prices can be higher or lower depending on exact location, road position, plot level, dues, seller urgency and special features.

## What affects Block C plot prices

The main price factors include:

- plot size
- exact street
- road width
- corner position
- park-facing position
- main-road or double-road access
- plot level
- possession
- outstanding dues
- nearby construction
- utilities
- seller urgency
- documentation status

A property near a main double road or commercial area may command a different asking price from a similar-sized internal-street plot.

For a fair comparison, compare like with like.

## Block C development and facilities

Block C is presented in current Phase 1 project material as an established area with facilities such as parks, mosques, educational institutions, apartment buildings and a civic and commercial centre.

Project material also references features such as a glow garden, grid station and cricket stadium in or around the Block C area.

For an actual purchase, inspect the immediate surroundings of the property rather than assuming every street has identical access to these facilities.

During a visit, check:

- road condition
- drainage
- street width
- nearby commercial activity
- utility condition
- surrounding occupancy
- plot level
- approach from Gate 2 or other practical access

## Block C houses for sale

Block C also has active house inventory.

Current portal listings include 5-marla houses and other built residential properties.

A house purchase requires more checks than a plot purchase.

In addition to ownership, transfer and location, inspect:

- construction age
- structural condition
- seepage
- electrical work
- plumbing
- roof condition
- finishing
- parking
- ventilation
- layout
- repair or renovation cost

A lower-priced house may require substantial work after purchase, so compare the total cost rather than only the asking price.

## Block C rentals

Some buyers and investors also consider Block C because of the established Phase 1 rental market.

If reviewing a property for rental income, check:

- current occupied or vacant status
- realistic monthly rent
- tenant demand
- house condition
- parking
- nearby services
- maintenance cost
- lease terms

Do not treat an advertised rent as guaranteed future income.

## Block C for end users

Block C may suit buyers who want an established Phase 1 location with a range of plot sizes, including smaller 5-marla options.

For family use, compare:

- access
- street environment
- nearby houses
- noise
- commercial activity
- road width
- plot orientation
- practical distance to daily services

A property that fits your daily use can be more valuable than a cheaper plot in a less suitable location.

## Block C for investors

Investors may focus more on entry price, plot size, road position, resale demand and the amount of competing inventory.

Before buying for investment, compare:

- current asking prices
- recent price-index direction
- exact location
- surrounding construction
- size-specific demand
- documentation
- total acquisition cost

Block C's mix of 5-, 8-, 10-, 14-marla and 1-kanal categories gives investors more size options, but each category has a different buyer pool.

## Block C vs Block A and Block B

Block C should be compared with Block A and Block B using the actual property, not simply the block name.

Compare:

- same or similar plot size
- street width
- access
- asking price
- possession
- corner or standard position
- surrounding development
- total payable amount

One practical difference is that Block C includes a 5-marla residential category, which can make it relevant to buyers with a smaller land budget.

The best block still depends on the exact property and intended use.

## What to check before buying in Block C

Before making an offer:

1. Confirm the property is in Faisal Town Phase 1/F-18 Block C.
2. Verify the plot or house number.
3. Match the location with the Phase 1 map.
4. Confirm documented dimensions.
5. Verify ownership documents.
6. Check transfer status.
7. Confirm possession.
8. Ask for outstanding dues.
9. Check any special-location premium.
10. Inspect the site physically.
11. Calculate taxes, transfer charges and other costs.
12. Obtain written payment and receipt details.

If the property description, map position and paperwork do not match, resolve the difference before payment.

## Block C site-visit checklist

During a site visit, check:

- exact plot or house
- road width
- approach route
- ground level
- drainage
- surrounding construction
- occupied houses
- nearby commercial activity
- corner or park-facing status
- utility availability
- any visible issue that could affect construction or resale

For remote buyers, request a live video walkthrough, map pin and current property documents.

## Do not confuse Block C with Faisal Town Phase 2

Block C on this page refers to Faisal Town Phase 1/F-18.

Faisal Town Phase 2 uses sector and enclave naming such as Sector O, Sector P, Sector R, Sector S, Sector T and Overseas Enclave.

If a listing uses only “C Block” or another vague label, confirm the exact project phase and map reference before comparing prices.
